title: Room plan
description: The space where the occasion takes place, to scale. Seating and fit checks start from here.

venue.title: Use the venue's plan
venue.body: Your venue has published approved plans. The plan enters the occasion at its current version; if the venue changes it later, you receive a proposal you accept or not.
venue.notCalibrated: The venue has not calibrated its drawing yet, so it cannot be used for seating.

own.name: Name of the space
own.dimsHint: Leave empty if you do not know it yet.

empty.title: No room plan yet
empty.body: Describe the space below so you can arrange the tables. If you add the venue from the business list to your suppliers, its approved plans appear here.

newer.title: The venue has published version {n} of the plan, valid from {date}
newer.body: Your plan stays on version {n} until you accept the change. Nothing changes by itself.
newer.notCalibrated: The new version is not calibrated, so it cannot be used in the plan.

facts.title: What we know about the space
facts.ownSource: Entered by you, not by the venue

inventory.title: The venue's tables
inventory.body: What the venue provides. You can also add tables of your own on the seating page.

settings.title: Space settings
settings.aisleHint: Free room between tables with the chairs pulled out. Usually 60 cm.

remove.title: Give up the room plan?
remove.body: The placed tables, the guests' seats and the stage variants are deleted too. Guests no longer see their seat.
remove.confirm: Delete the plan and the seating

errors.noModel: The occasion has no room plan yet. Choose one first.
errors.alreadyHasModel: The occasion already has a room plan. Give it up before choosing another.
errors.notCalibrated: This drawing is not calibrated, so it cannot be used for the plan or for fit checks.
errors.stale: The proposal is out of date: the plan has changed meanwhile. Discard it and ask for a new one.
errors.measure: Type a measure in metres, for example 12 or 8.5.

whatif.updateTitle: The venue has updated the plan “{name}”
whatif.name: Name of the space
whatif.becomesCustom: becomes a table of your own
whatif.overCount: The venue now has only {count} “{name}” tables.
whatif.typeGone: The venue no longer has this table type.
whatif.noLongerFits: no longer fits the usable area
whatif.customNote: A table of your own, not the venue's. Drawn with a dashed line.

guest.title: Room plan
guest.intro: Where to find what you need in the room.
guest.planLabel: Plan of the room {name}, with its points of interest
